clips.subtitleText: Level 1: Arcade patron holds high five up for an eternity while getting completely ignored
Level 2: Teammate leaps away so he smoothly saves it by clapping his own hands
Level 3: Kobe walks right past Phil Jackson leaving the legendary coach scratching his ear
Level 4: Polish First Lady walks straight past Trump's extended hand to shake Melania's
Level 5: Ryan Seacrest goes for a high five with a blind contestant on live national television
